'''Lori Jameson''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Jameson Base''' in the permit-locked '''Shinrarta Dezhra''' system. A descendant of the celebrated pilot John Jameson, she is discovered through '''[[Marco Qwent]]''' and works on scanners, exploration equipment, and ship-support modules.<ref name="inara-lori">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/20/ Lori Jameson — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-lori">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Lori_Jameson Lori Jameson], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Her highest-grade services are '''Grade 5 Sensors''' and '''Grade 5 Detailed Surface Scanner engineering'''. She also provides lower grades for eight other module families.<ref name="inara-lori" />

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Shinrarta Dezhra
* '''Facility:''' Jameson Base
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules
* '''Referral required:''' [[Marco Qwent]]
* '''System permit required:''' Yes — Founders World permit

Jameson Base is not Jameson Memorial. Both facilities are in Shinrarta Dezhra, but Lori's workshop is at Jameson Base.

== Access requirements ==

Lori's direct access conditions are:<ref name="inara-lori" />

# Reach Grade 3 access and progress approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with [[Marco Qwent]].
# Reach the Pilots Federation Combat rank of '''Dangerous''' or higher.
# Hold the Founders World permit required to enter Shinrarta Dezhra.
# Carry '''25 units of Kongga Ale''' to Jameson Base.
# Donate all 25 units to Lori.

The Founders World permit is separate from Lori's Dangerous Combat-rank requirement. Current permit references list Elite rank in Combat, Trade, Exploration, Mercenary, or Exobiology as the normal qualification; some legacy account entitlements also grant access.<ref name="edwiki-shinrarta">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Shinrarta_Dezhra Shinrarta Dezhra], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Kongga Ale is a rare commodity rather than a Raw, Manufactured, or Encoded Engineering material. The donation requires 25 tonnes of cargo capacity.

For Combat-rank progression, permit access, commodity acquisition, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Lori Jameson]].

{{Field note|Marco's referral reveals Lori. It does not satisfy her Dangerous-rank requirement, grant the Founders World permit, or complete the Kongga Ale donation.}}

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Lori increases by:<ref name="inara-lori" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop; or
* selling exploration data at Jameson Base.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Lori supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-lori" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]]. Among Lori's module families, the Shield Cell Bank supports Experimental Effects; her other listed specialties do not currently have them.<ref name="inara-lori" />

=== Operations-era services ===

Live adds two services that are not part of Legacy Engineering:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous — 4.4.0.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 27 May 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

* '''Long Range Detailed''' for the [[Detailed Surface Scanner]], available from Lori through Grade 5. It increases probe radius in exchange for greater mass and power draw and applies only to compatible Merc modules.<ref name="inara-dss-long">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/205/ Detailed Surface Scanner — Long Range Detailed], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Scoop Rate Enhanced''' for the [[Fuel Scoop]], available from Lori through Grade 4. It increases scoop rate in exchange for greater power draw and uses Merc Coin in its recipe.<ref name="inara-scoop">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/201/ Fuel Scoop — Scoop Rate Enhanced], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Lori blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade Lori offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Referrals ==

Lori does not currently introduce another Engineer in the ship Engineer referral network. Her relationship to Marco Qwent and the wider network can be viewed in the [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
